preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: for each edge, 1 <= p_j <= n and 1 <= a_j, b_j <= 10**9
preconditions.description: Each edge has valid ancestor and cost values.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output n-1 integers r_2, r_3, ..., r_n
postconditions.description: Output consists of n-1 integers for each test case.

postconditions.expression: for each vertex i (2 <= i <= n), r_i is the length of the maximum prefix of the path from the root to i such that the sum of b_j along this prefix does not exceed the sum of a_j along the same path
postconditions.description: Each r_i is calculated based on the path from the root to vertex i.
